name: legal-threats
description: Escalate any customer message that threatens legal action.

tests.text: I am going to sue your company!
I will involve my lawyers if this is not resolved.
I will take this to court if necessary.
I demand a chargeback for this transaction.
I am very unhappy with your service.
I want a refund for my broken blender.
I will file a complaint with the better business bureau.

built_from: Any customer message that threatens legal action (suing, lawyers, court, chargebacks) must be escalated to a human before the AI responds.
